items.title: Pope Leo celebrates open-air mass before 700,000 people in Paris

sentences.en: Pope Leo celebrates open-air mass before 700,000 people in Paris.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥在巴黎70万人面前庆祝露天弥撒。

sentences.en: Crowds line Place de la Concorde on second day of pontiff’s first official papal visit to France in 18 years Hundreds of thousands of people lined the Avenue des Champs-Élysées in ⁠Paris on Saturday to attend an open-air mass with Pope Leo, on the second day of his visit to France.
sentences.zh: 在教皇18年来首次正式访问法国的第二天，人群聚集在协和广场（ Place de la Concorde ）。周六，数十万人在巴黎香榭丽舍大街排队，与教皇利奥（ Leo ）在访问法国的第二天一起参加露天弥撒。

sentences.en: The Vatican estimated 700,000 people turned out for the outdoor mass with the 71-year-old American pope – about 100,000 more than the number of people who had registered to attend.
sentences.zh: 梵蒂冈估计有70万人与这位71岁的美国教皇一起参加户外弥撒，比登记参加的人数多出约10万人。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims

sentences.en: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims.
sentences.zh: 德国城镇禁止为纳粹受害者建造“绊脚石”纪念碑。

sentences.en: Germany's education minister has branded the ban on the small brass memorial plaques a "scandal".
sentences.zh: 德国教育部长将小黄铜纪念牌匾的禁令称为“丑闻”。

items.title: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election

sentences.en: Brazil's Lula bans online gambling ahead of presidential election.
sentences.zh: 巴西的卢拉在总统选举前禁止在线赌博。

sentences.en: Lula, who is currently in a tight presidential race against Flávio Bolsonaro, said the industry was a "cancer" that he must "remove".
sentences.zh: 卢拉目前正在与弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）进行激烈的总统竞选，他说该行业是一种“癌症” ，他必须“消除”。

items.title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says

sentences.en: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says.
sentences.zh: 评论说，犹他州校园的安全漏洞导致查理·柯克（ Charlie Kirk ）被杀。

sentences.en: The indpendent report also says Kirk's aides insisted he speak outdoors, overriding concerns from campus officials.
sentences.zh: 这份独立的报告还说，柯克的助手坚持他在户外说话，压倒了校园官员的担忧。

items.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens

sentences.en: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens.
sentences.zh: 在雅典卫城附近的建筑物爆炸中死亡的六名英国国民。

sentences.en: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.
sentences.zh: 官员说，四名美国人和一名希腊国民在可疑的天然气爆炸中丧生。

items.title: Trump rejects Iran’s seven-day peace deal to reopen strait of Hormuz

sentences.en: Trump rejects Iran’s seven-day peace deal to reopen strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗为期七天的重开霍尔木兹海峡的和平协议。

sentences.en: US president is said to expect renewed strikes after midterms US president Donald Trump has said he has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the strait of Hormuz within a week and resume nuclear talks in return for the lifting of the US naval blockade of Iranian ports.
sentences.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）表示，他已拒绝伊朗在一周内重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的提议，并恢复核谈判，以换取美国解除对伊朗港口的海军封锁。

sentences.en: “They made a proposal but I reject it,” he told reporters at the White House.
sentences.zh: “他们提出了一项建议，但我拒绝了，”他在白宫对记者说。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: The Takeaway: UN General Assembly debate Day 4

sentences.en: The Takeaway: UN General Assembly debate Day 4.
sentences.zh: 总结：联合国大会辩论第4天。

sentences.en: From the Caribbean to the Pacific, leaders from small island States demanded climate justice, ocean protection and greater solidarity at the UN General Assembly on Friday.
sentences.zh: 从加勒比到太平洋，小岛屿国家领导人周五在联合国大会上要求气候正义、海洋保护和更大的团结。

sentences.en: They warned that rising seas are already redrawing national boundaries, while the ripple effects of faraway wars are being felt on their shores.
sentences.zh: 他们警告说，海平面上升已经在重新划定国家边界，而遥远的战争的连锁反应正在他们的海岸上感受到。

sentences.en: This edition of The Takeaway summarizes key points made during the fourth day of the annual high-level debate.
sentences.zh: 本期《外卖》总结了年度高级别辩论第四天期间提出的要点。

items.title: Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age

sentences.en: Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age.
sentences.zh: 各国采用全球蓝图来应对数字时代快速发展的犯罪。

sentences.en: Countries adopted on Saturday a new global blueprint for tackling rapidly evolving forms of crime, as the UN’s largest gathering on crime prevention and criminal justice opened in Abu Dhabi with a call for stronger international cooperation.
sentences.zh: 随着联合国最大的预防犯罪和刑事司法会议在阿布扎比开幕，各国通过了一项应对快速发展的犯罪形式的新全球蓝图，呼吁加强国际合作。

items.title: ‘Safeguard the postwar order,’ China tells UN General Assembly

sentences.en: ‘Safeguard the postwar order,’ China tells UN General Assembly.
sentences.zh: “维护战后秩序，”中国告诉联合国大会。

sentences.en: China's Vice President, Han Zheng, urged the world to defend the postwar international order on Saturday, telling the UN General Assembly that geopolitical conflicts, widening development gaps and mounting global challenges make multilateralism more urgent than ever.
sentences.zh: 中国国家副主席韩正周六敦促世界捍卫战后国际秩序，他告诉联合国大会，地缘政治冲突、不断扩大的发展差距和日益严峻的全球挑战使多边主义比以往任何时候都更加紧迫。

items.title: Lavrov issues call for new Eurasian ‘security architecture’

sentences.en: Lavrov issues call for new Eurasian ‘security architecture’.
sentences.zh: 拉夫罗夫的问题需要新的欧亚“安全架构”。

sentences.en: Russia's Foreign Minister, Sergey Lavrov, accused Western countries of destabilising the world through “force and double standards” in his address to the UN General Assembly on Saturday, vowing that Moscow's “special military operation” in Ukraine would be “carried through to the end.”
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫（ Sergey Lavrov ）周六在联合国大会发言时指责西方国家通过“武力和双重标准”破坏世界稳定，并誓言莫斯科在乌克兰的“特别军事行动”将“进行到底”。

items.title: Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure

sentences.en: Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure.
sentences.zh: 古巴警告“丛林法则” ，外交部长谴责美国施压。

sentences.en: Cuba’s Foreign Minister warned the UN General Assembly on Saturday that escalating military and economic pressure in Latin America and the Caribbean was threatening international law, while accusing the United States of intensifying a decades-long campaign to isolate and weaken his country.
sentences.zh: 古巴外交部长周六警告联合国大会，拉丁美洲和加勒比地区不断升级的军事和经济压力正在威胁国际法，同时指责美国加强了长达数十年的孤立和削弱古巴的运动。

items.title: Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯警告说，在地区紧张局势下，海湾安全与全球稳定密不可分。

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister warned on Saturday that escalating threats across the Middle East risked international peace, energy security and global trade, calling for stronger international cooperation to protect Gulf States and vital shipping routes.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯外交部长周六警告说，整个中东地区不断升级的威胁威胁到国际和平、能源安全和全球贸易，呼吁加强国际合作，保护海湾国家和重要的航线。

items.title: Countries far from conflict paying the price for wars not their own, India tells UN

sentences.en: Countries far from conflict paying the price for wars not their own, India tells UN.
sentences.zh: 印度告诉联合国，远离冲突的国家为非本国的战争付出了代价。

sentences.en: India’s External Affairs Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar warned on Saturday that violent conflicts continue to undermine international peace and security, while countries far removed from the battlefield are being forced to pay a heavy price.
sentences.zh: 印度外交部长Subrahmanyam Jaishankar周六警告说，暴力冲突继续破坏国际和平与安全，而远离战场的国家正被迫付出沉重代价。

items.title: Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’

sentences.en: Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’.
sentences.zh: 随着全球秩序面临“破裂” ，加拿大敦促加强伙伴关系。

sentences.en: Canada’s Foreign Minister Anita Anand warned the UN General Assembly on Saturday that the international order has entered an era of profound disruption, calling for stronger multilateral cooperation and new partnerships as major powers increasingly turn away from global economic integration.
sentences.zh: 加拿大外交部长安妮塔·阿南德（ Anita Anand ）周六警告联合国大会，国际秩序已进入一个深刻混乱的时代，呼吁加强多边合作和新的伙伴关系，因为主要大国越来越远离全球经济一体化。

items.title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents

sentences.en: OPINION: Trump's U.N.
sentences.zh: 观点：特朗普的联合国

sentences.en: speech, a stark contrast with past presidents.
sentences.zh: 演讲，与前任总统形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在联合国面前公开沉思他是否应该消灭伊朗。

sentences.en: It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.
sentences.zh: 这与他的前任们谈论使用美国军事力量的方式形成了鲜明的对比。

items.title: Windy weddings and rocky cruises: How East Coasters are braving the nor'easter this weekend

sentences.en: Windy weddings and rocky cruises: How East Coasters are braving the nor'easter this weekend.
sentences.zh: 多风的婚礼和岩石巡游：东海岸如何在这个周末勇敢地迎接诺尔伊斯特。

sentences.en: Northeast states saw rising tides and widespread power outages on Saturday as the storm ripped through the region.
sentences.zh: 随着风暴席卷该地区，东北各州周六出现了涨潮和大面积停电。

sentences.en: Forecasters expect significant winds and rain throughout the weekend.
sentences.zh: 预报员预计整个周末都会有大风和降雨。

items.title: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic

sentences.en: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic.
sentences.zh: 为什么这个岛屿天堂有世界上增长最快的艾滋病毒流行。

sentences.en: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections.
sentences.zh: 9月中旬，由于艾滋病毒感染率惊人上升，斐济政府宣布进入国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.
sentences.zh: 该国的冰毒疫情是一个强有力的促成因素。

items.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits

sentences.en: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits.
sentences.zh: 美国的沙利度胺幸存者比政府承认的还要多。

sentences.en: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪50年代和60年代，医生在没有告知孕妇的情况下给予该药物沙利度胺，也没有获得FDA的批准。

sentences.en: Now those patients' children want recognition.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些患者的孩子需要得到认可。

sentences.zh: （图片来源： William J.

items.title: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health. Will they survive Medicaid cuts?

sentences.en: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health.
sentences.zh: 送餐可以节省费用并改善健康状况。

sentences.en: Will they survive Medicaid cuts?.
sentences.zh: 他们能否在医疗补助削减中幸存下来？

sentences.en: Some states deliver meals to Medicaid patients that address their dietary needs.
sentences.zh: 一些州向医疗补助患者提供满足其饮食需求的膳食。

sentences.en: Evidence shows it aids recovery and saves healthcare costs, but federal budget cuts may lead some states to cancel it.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明，它有助于恢复并节省医疗费用，但联邦预算削减可能会导致一些州取消它。

items.title: The AI safety debate is confusing. Here's our guide to the different factions

sentences.en: The AI safety debate is confusing.
sentences.zh: 人工智能安全辩论令人困惑。

sentences.en: Here's our guide to the different factions.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们不同派系的指南。

sentences.en: The battle over AI's promise and perils is not a clash between two opposing sides, but a debate among a range of competing voices and ideologies.
sentences.zh: 围绕人工智能的前景和危险的斗争不是两个对立方之间的冲突，而是一系列相互竞争的声音和意识形态之间的辩论。

sentences.en: Here is a guide to who's who in that debate.

items.title: Lula bans fixed-odds sports betting a week before Brazilian elections

sentences.en: Lula bans fixed-odds sports betting a week before Brazilian elections.
sentences.zh: 卢拉禁止在巴西选举前一周进行体育博彩。

sentences.en: President’s ‘hard, drastic and necessary measure’, likely to attract widespread public support, polls suggest The Brazilian president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has signed an order banning fixed-odds sports betting just over a week before the first round of the presidential election, in a move he said was designed to tackle the pervasive problem of families falling into debt.
sentences.zh: 民意调查显示，巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）在第一轮总统选举前一周签署了一项禁止固定赔率体育博彩的命令，称此举旨在解决家庭陷入债务的普遍问题。

sentences.en: The decision ends the operation, offering, intermediation and advertising of betting.
sentences.zh: 该决定结束投注的运营、发行、中介和广告。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared

sentences.en: Bangkok roads submerged as flood disaster declared.
sentences.zh: 随着洪水灾害的宣布，曼谷的道路被淹没。

sentences.en: An emergency has been declared across the capital of Thailand as days of heavy rain leave the city inundated.
sentences.zh: 泰国首都宣布进入紧急状态，因为几天的大雨使该市被淹没。

items.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip

sentences.en: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip.
sentences.zh: 教皇警告说，当他开始法国之行时， “机器的天堂”可能会破坏人类。

sentences.en: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥十四世警告说， “机器的天堂”可能会破坏人类。

sentences.en: He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.
sentences.zh: 他在访问法国期间提出了对人工智能、核武器和人权的担忧。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Teresa Suarez)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Teresa Suarez ）

items.title: Drones could speed up getting defibrillators to people having cardiac arrests, study suggests

sentences.en: Drones could speed up getting defibrillators to people having cardiac arrests, study suggests.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，无人机可以加快向心脏骤停患者提供除颤器的速度。

sentences.en: New research suggests the technology could be used to increase out-of-hospital access to life-saving devices Drones could help cut the time it takes to get a defibrillator to people experiencing cardiac arrests when not in hospital, researchers have suggested.
sentences.zh: 研究人员建议，新的研究表明，这项技术可以用于增加院外获得救生设备的机会，无人机可以帮助缩短将除颤器送到院外心脏骤停患者所需的时间。

sentences.en: In the UK alone, there are more than 30,000 out-of-hospital cardiac arrests a year where emergency medical services attempt to resuscitate the individual, according to the British Heart Foundation.
sentences.zh: 根据英国心脏基金会的数据，仅在英国，每年就有超过3万例院外心脏骤停，紧急医疗服务试图使患者复苏。

sentences.en: However, fewer than one in 10 people survive such an event, and some who do are left with neurological problems.
sentences.zh: 然而，只有不到十分之一的人幸存下来，有些人患有神经系统疾病。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites

sentences.en: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites.
sentences.zh: OpenAI机器人干涉了多个美国政府机构网站。

sentences.en: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises.
sentences.zh: OpenAI表示，其机器人在测试演习期间访问了来自各种机构的公共数据。

items.title: British climber, 28, dies in fall in northern Spain

sentences.en: British climber, 28, dies in fall in northern Spain.
sentences.zh: 28岁的英国登山者在西班牙北部的秋天去世。

sentences.en: Mountaineer’s body recovered about 20 metres below the summit of Torrecerredo, the highest peak of the Picos de Europa range A British man has died after falling about 61 metres (200ft) while descending from the summit of a mountain in northern Spain, according to local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 根据当地执法部门的说法，登山者的尸体在Torrecerredo山顶下方约20米处恢复，这是Picos de Europa山脉的最高峰。一名英国男子在从西班牙北部的一座山峰下坠约61米（ 200英尺）后死亡。

sentences.en: The 28-year-old mountaineer fell down a vertical gully on the east side of the Torrecerredo – the highest peak of the Cantabrian mountains – on Thursday afternoon, the Spanish Civil Guard for the Asturias region said.
sentences.zh: 阿斯图里亚斯地区的西班牙国民警卫队表示，这名28岁的登山者周四下午在坎塔布里亚山脉最高峰托雷塞雷多（ Torrecerredo ）东侧的垂直沟壑上摔倒。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC

sentences.en: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC.
sentences.zh: 南非白人种族灭绝并不存在，新任驻美国大使告诉BBC。

sentences.en: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.
sentences.zh: Roelf Meyer告诉英国广播公司，作为一名白人南非白人，他有权质疑特朗普关于种族灭绝的说法。

items.title: Michigan CEO loses job after posting AI-made image of her family in ‘Lake America’ sweaters

sentences.en: Michigan CEO loses job after posting AI-made image of her family in ‘Lake America’ sweaters.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州首席执行官在“美国湖”毛衣上发布了AI制作的家庭形象后失业。

sentences.en: Jane Smith reportedly used ChatGPT to edit photo to show name Trump ordered US agencies to use for Lake Ontario amid trade war with Canada The CEO of a Michigan credit union is no longer employed there, according to the organization, after she posted on social media what appeared to be an AI-generated image of her and her family wearing sweaters emblazoned with the Donald Trump-associated words “ Lake America ”.
sentences.zh: 据报道，简·史密斯（ Jane Smith ）使用ChatGPT编辑照片，展示特朗普命令美国机构在与加拿大的贸易战中为安大略湖使用的名称。据该组织称，密歇根州一家信用合作社的首席执行官在社交媒体上发布了她和家人穿着印有唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）相关词语“美国湖” （ Lake America ）的毛衣的人工智能图像后，不再受雇于该组织。

sentences.en: In the statement recently announcing that Jane Smith would no longer be its CEO, Family First Credit Union also apologized “for the concern, disappointment and pain this situation has caused”.
sentences.zh: 在最近宣布简·史密斯将不再担任其首席执行官的声明中， Family First Credit Union也“为这种情况造成的担忧、失望和痛苦”道歉。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says

sentences.en: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says.
sentences.zh: 泽伦斯基说，俄罗斯以“日常生活”为目标，攻击乌克兰的数据中心。

sentences.en: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统表示，此类罢工旨在破坏“人们保持联系、学习和工作的能力”。

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases

sentences.en: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases.
sentences.zh: 初学者版GitHub Copilot应用：如何使用画布构建自定义工作流程。

sentences.en: Most tools give you a fixed set of screens and ask you to fit your work into them.
sentences.zh: 大多数工具为您提供一组固定的屏幕，并要求您将工作与屏幕相匹配。

sentences.en: But what if you could start with the workflow you want instead and have the interface take shape around it?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以从你想要的工作流程开始，让界面围绕它成形呢？

sentences.en: That s the idea behind canvases in the GitHub Copilot app .
sentences.zh: 这就是GitHub Copilot应用程序中画布背后的想法。

sentences.en: A canvas, also called a canvas extension, is a customizable interface that you and the agent share.
sentences.zh: 画布，也称为画布扩展，是您和代理共享的可自定义界面。

sentences.en: It can be a kanban board, an issue triage board, a release checklist, a dashboard, a form, or even a spreadsheet: a UI shaped to how you work.
sentences.zh: 它可以是工作流程看板、问题分类板、发布清单、仪表板、表单，甚至是电子表格：根据您的工作方式塑造的用户界面。

sentences.en: Because the canvas is bidirectional, the agent can update it as it works, and you can use buttons, cards, filters, and other controls to make changes too.
sentences.zh: 由于画布是双向的，代理可以随时更新，您也可以使用按钮、卡片、筛选器和其他控件进行更改。

sentences.en: Just like using a live shared whiteboard.
sentences.zh: 就像使用实时共享白板一样。

sentences.en: Let s create one.
sentences.zh: 让我们创建一个。

sentences.en: Creating a canvas with /create-canvas To create a canvas, you don t have to do any coding or design by hand.
sentences.zh: 使用/create-canvas创建画布要创建画布，您不必手动进行任何编码或设计。

sentences.en: Just open an agent session, enter the /create-canvas skill , and describe what you want in plain English.
sentences.zh: 只需打开客服代表会话，输入/create-canvas技能，并用简单的英语描述您想要的内容。

sentences.en: Make sure your prompt covers three things: The workflow the canvas should support.
sentences.zh: 请确保您的提示包含三项内容：画布应支持的工作流程。

items.title: Alberta’s self-image as world’s only rat-free region shattered by discovery of rat

sentences.en: Alberta’s self-image as world’s only rat-free region shattered by discovery of rat.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯塔省作为世界上唯一没有老鼠的地区的自我形象因发现老鼠而破灭。

sentences.en: Province’s rat patrol called in to investigate as town of Bowden announces discovery of dead vermin For more than seven decades, residents of Alberta have shared something in common with Antarctica and the high Arctic: all locations are officially free of rats.
sentences.zh: 七十多年来，艾伯塔省的居民与南极洲和高纬度北极地区有着共同之处：所有地点都正式没有老鼠。

sentences.en: But on Thursday the Canadian province’s reputation as a firewall against rodent infestation took a hit when the town of Bowden announced the discovery of a dead rat and called on the province’s “rat patrol” to investigate.
sentences.zh: 但周四，当鲍登镇宣布发现一只死老鼠并呼吁该省的“老鼠巡逻队”进行调查时，加拿大省作为防止啮齿动物侵扰的防火墙的声誉受到了打击。

items.title: Novelist accused of using AI to write book removed from French prize list

sentences.en: Novelist accused of using AI to write book removed from French prize list.
sentences.zh: 小说家被指控使用人工智能撰写从法国奖品清单中删除的书籍。

sentences.en: Thélyson Orélien had been in the running to win a top literary prize before the AI claim emerged on social media The organisers of France’s most prestigious literary prize said they had removed a critically acclaimed novel by a Canadian-Haitian writer from the longlist after an anonymous online account claimed the book was “almost entirely” written by AI.
sentences.zh: Thélyson Orélien在人工智能声称在社交媒体上出现之前，一直在争夺最高文学奖。法国最负盛名的文学奖的组织者表示，在一个匿名在线帐户声称这本书“几乎完全”由人工智能撰写后，他们已将一位加拿大-海地作家广受好评的小说从长名单中删除。

sentences.en: The Académie Goncourt, a Paris-based literary organisation, said on Friday its decision to withdraw Thélyson Orélien’s novel C’était ça ou mourir (It Was That or Die) was “driven by the desire to preserve the integrity of the Goncourt prize and the academy itself, whose central role is to promote and honour literature written by women and men”.
sentences.zh: 总部位于巴黎的文学组织Académie Goncourt周五表示，它决定撤回Thélyson Orélien的小说C 'était ça ou mourir (It Was That or Die)是“出于维护Goncourt奖和学院本身的完整性的愿望，其核心作用是促进和尊重女性和男性写的文学”。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读
